pattern_id: Execution deadlock from unbounded busy-wait in Tarjan SCC when dependency not committed
description: Execution engine deadlock due to unbounded busy-wait in strongconnect when processing transitive dependencies
trigger_condition: 1) Command X is COMMITTED with dependencies. 2) Transitive dependency Z is PREACCEPTED but not COMMITTED. 3) Z's leader crashed. 4) strongconnect enters unbounded busy-wait for Z. 5) Recovery for Z cannot be triggered because executeCommands loop is blocked.
root_cause: Unbounded busy-wait loop in strongconnect (Tarjan's SCC algorithm) with no timeout. Recovery trigger is in the blocked executeCommands loop, creating circular dependency: execution waits for recovery, recovery cannot start.
fix_approach: Add timeout to busy-wait loop. Implement async recovery triggering separate from execution loop.
